blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) has denied a post circulating on social media that two individual died during a rally coinciding with the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law on Monday. In a statement on Tuesday, the NCRPO said its real-time monitoring and reports from personnel on the ground showed that “no fatalities or casualties occurred during the activity.” “There was a brief moment of tension, but the situation was quickly resolved through dialogue and the strict observance of maximum tolerance,” the NCRPO said, pertaining to the two youths who were supposedly “pacified” by police […]...
